evidence.claim: The company reports operating manufacturing sites in three countries: Addison, Illinois, USA; Tuas Avenue, Singapore; and Ballyvourney, Macroom County Cork, Ireland, to supply engineered flexible materials to the healthcare industry, according to its official corporate web portal.

An announcement by equipment supplier BOBST states that PAXXUS Ireland upgraded its manufacturing capacity by investing in dual MASTER M6 presses to replace legacy flexo machinery at its facility in Ireland.

Global Manufacturing & Sales Footprint.assessed_on: We verified that the company has a confirmed manufacturing footprint across three countries (USA, Singapore, and Ireland) serving the global healthcare packaging and flexible materials market. Based on primary research, the company's geographic distribution of sales offices can be estimated as limited to a few markets, based on its 3 primary manufacturing and corporate hubs in the United States, Singapore, and Ireland.

estimates.basis: its 3 primary manufacturing and corporate hubs in the United States, Singapore, and Ireland

evidence.claim: The company reported a global asset expansion project in December 2020 that included the installation of a new Windmöller & Hölscher 7-layer blown film line in its Singapore facility for medical forming webs and new Bobst adhesive laminators in its United States and Ireland facilities, according to a company project update.

The company invested in dual BOBST MASTER M6 printing presses integrated into its cleanroom operations to run flexible healthcare packaging jobs 35% to 40% faster for blister lids and pouch applications, according to a case study by BOBST.

Medical Segment Investment & Capacity.assessed_on: The rating rests on documented capital equipment acquisitions and global production expansions across three continents. Based on primary research, the company's annual film production capacity can be estimated as growing steadily, based on its multi million dollar asset upgrades including new 7 layer blown film lines and laminators.

estimates.basis: its multi million dollar asset upgrades including new 7 layer blown film lines and laminators
estimates.source: PAXXUS, Inc. Global Expansion Asset Updates

evidence.claim: The company reports that it was formed globally by combining Rollprint Packaging Products in the USA, Alliantz Flexible Packaging in Singapore, and EuroFoil Teo in Ireland to serve as a vertically integrated developer of engineered flexible materials for the healthcare industry.

Market Share & Competitive Position.assessed_on: We verified that the company operates as a global entity formed by combining regional flexible packaging manufacturers. Based on primary research, the company's global market share figures can be estimated as high, based on its products touching over 3 billion patient lives every year globally.

estimates.basis: its products touching over 3 billion patient lives every year globally
estimates.source: PAXXUS, Inc. Corporate Overview and Working Profiles
